meta.portco: Commonwealth Electrical Technologies (CET; Worcester + Taunton offices; NuWave, Norwell) — plus residential home sales in the same counties per user request

method.county_assignment: TOWN_ID joined to MassGIS Massachusetts_Municipalities/FeatureServer/1 (TOWN_ID -> COUNTY); each county queried with TOWN_ID IN (...)

queries.non_residential: LS_DATE >= '20240901' AND LS_DATE <= '20260924' AND (USE_CODE LIKE '0%' OR USE_CODE LIKE '3%' OR USE_CODE LIKE '4%' OR USE_CODE LIKE '9%')
queries.residential: LS_DATE >= '20250901' AND LS_DATE <= '20260924' AND USE_CODE LIKE '1%'

method.params: outFields=<subset>, returnGeometry=false, returnCentroid=true, outSR=4326, orderByFields=OBJECTID, resultRecordCount=2000, paged via resultOffset until exceededTransferLimit=false
method.use_code_normalization: Non-digits stripped; 4-digit codes truncated to first 3 digits (e.g. 3400->340, 0130->013), except leading-zero-padded residential codes (0101->101). 0xx (DOR mixed-use) -> mixed; 1xx -> residential (13x -> land); 3xx -> commercial (39x -> land); 4xx -> industrial (44x -> land); 9xx exempt/institutional -> other; 000 -> other. 2xx/5xx/6xx/7xx/8xx excluded.

segments.residential_window: 2025-09-01..2026-09-24 (1xx residential incl. condos, 1-3 family, apartments 111/112; 13x residential vacant land tagged land)

caveats: Source is the assessor roll, not deeds: each parcel carries only its LAST sale (LS_DATE/LS_PRICE). Parcels that sold more than once in the window appear once, with the most recent sale.

buyer = OWNER1 (current owner of record on the town's FY2026/FY2027 roll). This is normally the grantee of the last sale but may lag or reflect a later non-sale transfer. seller is not published in this layer -> null; builder_flag therefore null for all records.

arms_length is false only where price <= $1,000 (nominal-consideration transfers, 15914 records); otherwise null. No NAL/validity code is exposed in the current layer (the old LA3_Sales_Parcels_gdb layer with NAL_CODE was last updated 2023-01 and was not used).

Lag: towns update the statewide layer on their own cadence (FY2026 rolls mostly through ~2026-01; some FY2027 rolls through 2026-06/07). Latest sale date per county ranges 2026-03-13 (Suffolk) to 2026-07-25 (Hampden); monthly volume drops sharply after 2026-01 because of this lag, not a market decline. Nothing after 2026-07-25 is present.

Suffolk County covers Chelsea, Revere and Winthrop only. Boston (TOWN_ID 35) is in the layer but its data is a FY2023 snapshot with essentially no sales after 2024-09-01, so Boston transfers are absent.
lat/lon are MassGIS parcel polygon centroids (returnCentroid, WGS84), rounded to 5 decimals. Condo units share one parcel polygon, so multiple condo sales can share coordinates.
zip is sparse (many towns leave ZIP blank in L3); sqft = BLD_AREA (gross) falling back to RES_AREA; beds not available (NUM_ROOMS is total rooms, not bedrooms).
use_code_raw retains the town-specific 3/4-character code; many towns append a 4th digit or letter subclass. use_desc is MassGIS standardized description.

Institutional/exempt (9xx) transfers are tagged use_type=other; mixed-use (0xx, e.g. 013/031) tagged mixed. Residential records were included because the user asked for home sales in all counties the BSP portcos serve; filter use_type!=residential for the commercial CET view.

Nominal-price transfers are common: 15914 of 35316 records (45%) have price <= $1,000 (mostly $1/$10/$100 deeds to trusts, family or affiliated LLCs); kept and flagged arms_length=false. Filter price > 1000 for market sales.

Multi-parcel deeds: the total consideration is repeated on every parcel in the deed (e.g. the Dec-2024 Moderna Norwood campus shows $259.4M on 3 parcels), so do not sum price across rows without grouping by deed_ref + sale_date.

QA 2026-09-24: Validated schema/date/price/geo integrity on all 35,316 records. Removed 15,903 records with non-null price < $1,000 (nominal-consideration deed stamps: $1/$10/$100/$0 trust/family/LLC transfers, ~45% of the file) per QA threshold price >= $1,000 or null; these were already flagged arms_length=false in the source data and are documented above, not deleted from provenance notes. No duplicate ids, no missing state/county/sale_date/addr-or-latlon, no out-of-bounds MA lat/lon found among remaining 19,413 records. meta.coverage counts and item_count recomputed from the retained records. Spot-checked item ma-159-351_132_67-2026-07-25 (Longmeadow, Hampden) against a live re-query of the MassGIS Massachusetts_Property_Tax_Parcels FeatureServer/0 (LOC_ID=F_374353_2843870): LS_DATE 20260725, LS_PRICE 825000, SITE_ADDR '393 GREEN HILL RD', OWNER1 'POOLE, LAUREN A', USE_CODE 1014, YEAR_BUILT 1984, BLD_AREA 6182 — all fields matched exactly. File size 25.5MB before, well under the 30MB cap, so no per-county trimming was needed.
Trimmed for CET use on 2026-09-24: kept commercial/industrial/mixed/other use types and land ≥ $500k (4,317 of 19,413 transfers); residential rows removed.
